units: <cite ref="Gittin 53a:19">Gitt. 53ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ שאינו ניכר</he> a damage not discernible in the object itself (e.g. if an unclean person touches food, whereby its value is reduced, because the scope of its use is limited).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:14">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>שן יש הנאה להֶיזֵּיקָהּ</he> the damage done by the tooth is connected with a benefit (to the animal).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>רגל הזיקה מצוי</he> the damage by the foot is an ordinary occurrence (and must be guarded against).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:4:4">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> top <he>ה׳ חמין</he> possible injury to health by the hot bath.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:2">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>דבר של ה׳</he> an obnoxious thing (animal); a. fr.
